findings.title: Release path runs after partial commit without verifying op state
findings.issue: `_abandon_operation` only acts when the operation is exactly 'reserved', but `question`'s finally calls it after `complete_with_receipt`; that is correct fail-closed behavior here (no prepared/unknown reset) and there is no leak on the tested oversized-context path. However a single-group `execute_reserved` failure path settles 'unknown' and a later abandon silently no-ops, which is intended — no executable P0/P1 was found in the declared lines.
findings.fix: Keep the state check as-is; optionally add an explicit test that an oversized context after a prepared text operation leaves that operation untouched.

not_verified: Composition/deletion/worker code outside declared lines 43-100 of composition.py is not reviewed.
#52 media scope/page/download closure and #64 model/accounting closure are separate snapshots and not re-reviewed here.
Behavior of ScopedModelClient.complete_with_receipt body-size validation and its exact exception type is not in the supplied excerpts.
Concurrency between sweep/cleanup and in-flight extract is not covered by the supplied tests.
findings.summary: The declared media changes behave fail-closed: `question`'s finally releases only still-`reserved` operations via `_abandon_operation`, so oversized context produces no HTTP and zero consumption while prepared/unknown operations are never reset; guard fencing runs after `extract`, after local extraction, and immediately before text transport via the passed guard, and the cancelled-extraction test shows StateConflict before any model operation or HTTP. Bounds (body size, page shape, multibyte length) and the unknown-price rule are enforced, reservations are returned in finally, and the two cited new tests cover the failure paths with 43 passing. No executable P0 or P1 defect was found in the reviewed lines.
